summary.text: Bo Watson is a Republican state senator from Hixson who represents Tennessee Senate District 11 in part of Hamilton County and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A physical therapist by profession, he chairs the Senate Finance, Ways and Means Committee and the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bo Watson was born on October 21, 1960, and works as a physical therapist at Parkridge Medical Center, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
He earned a B.A. in biology, magna cum laude, from the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga and studied physical therapy at the University of Tennessee Center for Health Sciences in Memphis.

Watson served in the Tennessee House during the 104th General Assembly, co-chairing the House Republican Caucus Bill Review, and has been a member of the Senate from the 105th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He was Speaker Pro Tempore of the Senate during the 108th and 109th General Assemblies.
He also chairs the Senate Rules Committee and is vice-chair of the Council on Pensions and a member of the Fiscal Review, Commerce and Labor, and Health and Welfare committees.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the August 6, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Tim Roberts in the general election.
His community involvement includes teaching Sunday school, serving on the Baylor School board of trustees, and volunteering with Habitat for Humanity and the American Heart Association.
